name: generic-resource-graph-productization-static-http-tree-identity-contract
purpose: Define retained static HTTP tree-identity reexec evidence and fail-closed refusals. The selected rows no longer route as product move continuation because target-native static HTTP reexec is not modeled live-state continuation.

requiredStaticRootIdentity.sourceEvidence: source static-root tree digest captured from the exact served root
requiredStaticRootIdentity.targetEvidence: target static-root tree digest verified before target launch
requiredStaticRootIdentity.digestPolicy: same normalized file count, directory count, byte count, path set, and sha256 tree digest
requiredStaticRootIdentity.driftBehavior: fail closed before target launch or return refused loader with targetPid=null

productizableRows.resourceShape: exact Node static HTTP server with target-native Node reexec, runtime-owned libuv fds recreated target-side, idle loopback listener, and exact static-root tree identity
treeIdentityRequirements: source static root digest captured from nodeStaticHttpState.cwd
target static root digest verified before Node target reexec
directoryIdentity resourceClass is supported only when source and target digests match
tree drift, missing root, symlink policy drift, and digest mismatch refuse before target launch
targetEvidenceRequirements: target HTTP /health proof returns expected body/status
tree-drift refusal cases keep targetPid=null or prevent target launch
nonClaims: no timer, worker, native addon, or dynamic script support
